Comments (English): [ It doesn't wash well and there's a lot of moisture inside, so it's very uncomfortable. ] || ---------------- || There's a door-opening function, but the hot air only dries the dishes to a certain degree, leaving a lot of moisture in many areas. It seems like it would take too long to let it dry with the door open, and even with the door slightly open, the moisture inside doesn't dry. After washing, there's so much moisture on the ceiling, walls, and floor that I can't close the door and have to wipe it all down with a towel. I'm worried that leaving it alone will lead to mold and bacteria growth. After a pre-wash and running the machine, I noticed that the water flow wasn't strong enough to remove debris from the cutlery. I had to take it out and wash the dishes by hand. I suspect the lack of water flow is due to the inability to open the machine. It wasn't until after installation that I realized it was different from other models, as it lacks a rotating blade that sprays water onto the ceiling. The manual also indicates that it uses significantly more electricity and tap water than domestic models. Sentence (English): Dishwasher looks great and I have been a fan of MaytagFor many years with great results.
Comments (English): Dishwasher looks great and I have been a fan of MaytagFor many years with great results. BUT when my plumber installed he found a main factory installed drain line had a leak. Tried calling HD butSince it was beyond the 48 hours since delivery -was delivered New Year's Eve-and then my plumber had a death in his family-they said I'd have to use the manufacturers warranty. BUT based on my location there is no one that services my area. Was given Maytag's number and I was left on hold for 1 hr 15 min on a Friday afternoon and finally hung up. Called my local appliance repair and he came out last week and now has the part in all of which I am paying for out of pocket. Looked up ordering a new dishwasher and it's now $200 more a month later so I'm better to just pay to get a brand new never used unit fixed. I realize stuff happens but not serving your warranty and then not wanting to pay a repair place for their time to look at it, diagnose and install part which takes 2 trips is a bit frustrating. Oh and I am 85 miles one way to my nearest HD. But it looks great sitting in my kitchen and yes I would order it again.

Sentence (English): I kind of made a mistake buying this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Kind of good, kind of dissappointing. ] || ---------------- || I kind of made a mistake buying this dishwasher. I had purchased a Samsung white bespoke glass-front dishwasher last year for one of my homes and was very pleased with it. So, when sale pricing popped up near Christmas and I needed to replace another dishwasher, I thought I'd re-order another like it. But then, I saw I could trade up a notch and get a lower decibel noise level with this one. Sadly, I didn't notice that one of the key features I liked with the previous was missing. That is, a forward facing digital countdown that can be seen across the room with the door closed. There is indeed a countdown display on the horizontal control panel at the top of the door, but you can't see it with the door closed and in operation. That is kind of useless. Second, it keeps nagging me verbally to enable something called Baxter. Phooey! That's annoying. Thirdly, it smells like hot rubber when in operation. 4th, instead of a series of obvious buttons on the panel which are ez-pz to operate, one has to scroll through a digital display, plus three buttons. All-in-all, I'm a little disappointed with the purchase, but it is indeed very quiet, and the interior fitments do seem to be high quality. But I'll replace it with something else when I have the chance.

Sentence (English): So let me get the good out of the way.
Comments (English): [ Decent Dishwasher, Terrible Delivery Experience ] || ---------------- || So let me get the good out of the way. Once you receive the right dishwasher and get it repaired (more on that later) it seems to be a pretty decent dishwasher! It is way quieter than my previous dishwasher (which was quiet), is easy to operate, has adjustable racks and a third rack and gets the dishes relatively clean. I say relatively as there seems to be a trade off on the eco model, less water, must pre-clean dishes. If not for the delivery experience I'd probably buy it again. The delivery experience was terrible. First and foremost when you pay nearly a grand for a dishwasher and they ask $150 more for installation it gets pretty cost prohibitive quick. As I'm a relatively handy guy who has installed more than one dishwasher I opted to forego the installation, which in this case was a big mistake. Why? Well let me tell you. The first dishwasher was delivered quickly and the delivery guys were very fast and friendly. I unpacked it and everything looked good. The front was covered with a film that I opted to not take off to protect it while installing it. Second mistake. Once I got the unit installed and took the film off I realized it didn't look exactly like the picture. They delivered the wrong unit! The one received was a significantly lower end model. While disappointed I had to accept my mistake in not fully inspecting it before installing it. I reached out to Lowes to get it exchanged and asked if they would throw in installation due to their mistake. That was met with a flat no, that was separate and there was nothing they could do about it. Disappointing. So delivery day comes again (I'm now going on a week since I ordered it with no dishwasher). Eureka it's the correct unit! Only problem is, the top rack is busted! I contact them again asking if they can replace the rack and they said they'd send a repairman out the next day so I installed the second unt.The next day comes and the company they called reaches out to tell me they aren't sure why they were contacted by Lowes as they do not do repairs. They called the delivery company to do the repairs! I contact Lowes again and the lady I spoke with apologized profusely for the difficulties and offered a full refund and I can keep the dishwasher. Naturally I gladly accepted and my faith in companies doing the right thing was bolstered on this wonderful offer. I then arrange to have the repairs done myself and await my refund. That never came. Several calls and messages later I'm told she did not have the authority to offer a full refund and the best they can do is $100 off. While this covers my expense to get it repaired, it does not cover the time spent trying to get it completed and is far less than what was promised. I had no choice but to accept it but needless to say, I'll never buy another appliance (likely not another anything) from Lowes again. Very disappointing.

Sentence (English): Dishwasher looks great and I have been a fan of Maytag.
Comments (English): Dishwasher looks great and I have been a fan of Maytag. For many years with great results. BUT when my plumber installed he found a main factory installed drain line had a leak. Tried calling HD but. Since it was beyond the 48 hours since delivery -was delivered New Year's Eve-and then my plumber had a death in his family-they said I'd have to use the manufacturers warranty. BUT based on my location there is no one that services my area. Was given Maytag's number and I was left on hold for 1 hr 15 min on a Friday afternoon and finally hung up. Called my local appliance repair and he came out last week and now has the part in all of which I am paying for out of pocket. Looked up ordering a new dishwasher and it's now $200 more a month later so I'm better to just pay to get a brand new never used unit fixed. I realize stuff happens but not serving your warranty and then not wanting to pay a repair place for their time to look at it, diagnose and install part which takes 2 trips is a bit frustrating. Oh and I am 85 miles one way to my nearest HD. But it looks great sitting in my kitchen and yes I would order it again.

Sentence (English): We have never done a product review but what has happened to us is so egregious that we felt compelled to inform others.
Comments (English): [ Buyer Beware ] || ---------------- || We have never done a product review but what has happened to us is so egregious that we felt compelled to inform others. We bought this Kitchenaid dishwasher on July 28, 2025 and it was installed by Home Depot early August 2025. On December 11, 2025 the machine stopped working and a service request was made. Since then, we have been told that the machine needs a new main control board, new pump, new heating element and new water inlet to name just a few things. We were also told that the heating element failed. The appliance repair contractor hired by Whirlpool to do the work either reschedules the appointments, does not show up or orders the wrong parts. Today is January 19, 2026 and we had yet another scheduled appointment. Again, the repairman did not show up or even call. It is now more than 40 days since our new Kitchenaid stopped working. We have called Whirpool twice and asked for a replacement dishwasher, especially given the number of parts requiring replacement and the length of time we have been without a dishwasher. Whirlpool's response has been that that they are operating within the warranty and see no issue with the timeline thus far for the repair of our dishwasher. We are extremely disappointed and will never again buy a Whirlpool or Kitchenaid product.Buyer Beware and always read the warranty before you make the purchase.

Sentence (English): Got this dishwasher just after Christmas.
Comments (English): [ Unexpected Christmas Present ] || ---------------- || Got this dishwasher just after Christmas. The installation instructions that came with the dishwasher lacked a lot! After finding the PDF online of the instruction manual (this was after we had installed the dishwasher) I could see steps we figured out on our own that were not in the paper instructions. Please send the COMPLETE instruction manual for installation - save the next guy a bunch of headaches! The clamps on the hoses are a pain - too difficult to pinch open and closed while trying to slide it in the correct position. So we changed those to the good old kind with the screw for tightening - much better and more secure. The insulation that goes around the unit was a pain to keep on while pushing the dishwasher into place - nothing some duct tape didn't fix. There has to be a better way with that. Overall, once we got the unit in and we tried it out; it did a great job washing the dishes. One thing I absolutely hate is the silverware caddy! I'm looking online to see if I can find something better. The random sized slots in no pattern is a pain when trying to put silverware in it. I have had too many forks and knives bounce out of the caddy because I didn't get the utensil in a big enough slot. Very frustrating. And when I took off the tops (with the silverware slots) it's just big open areas underneath - come on, there are better designs than this. There is a 3rd rack on top which I like but I wish there were more guards on the front of the rack so things wouldn't slide out so easily. I like the different levels of cleaning and I really like the ProMax Dry - works great! It's noisier than I thought it would be. It's not awful but you definitely know it's on. All in all it's a good unit - seems solid and I'm hoping it lasts a while!

Sentence (English): To be honest, I bought the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher for the convenience, but I didn't expect it to change my life to this extent.
Comments (English): [ Free from the dishes, dinner is different. ] || ---------------- || To be honest, I bought the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher for the convenience, but I didn't expect it to change my life to this extent. First of all, the 14-seater size gives me a sense of stability. It doesn't feel like I'm just running it to load a few plates. I can fit everything I used today—pots, frying pans, soup bowls, even rice bowls. I can even throw everything in without worrying about anything, and there's still plenty of room. The design is truly remarkable. As expected from an Objet Collection, it's discreet and blends seamlessly with the kitchen cabinets. With the door closed, it looks like just another cabinet, without overly framing the dishwasher. Honestly, I'm impressed with its cleaning power. Dried rice cakes, oily pans—I wonder if I should just wipe them by hand? One run and they're all cleaned up. I used to do a quick wash, but these days, I just rinse them and put them back in. It's also quieter than I expected. I know it's running, but I still wonder if it's actually running. I can even run it at night without any problems. And here's the real kicker. I don't think about washing dishes. After eating, the dishwashing routine disappears. Instead, I just put it in, press the button, and it's done. It becomes a habit. To summarize, the large capacity makes it especially good for families and homes that cook frequently. The cleaning power is reliable, so it's quiet and has a clean design. The stress of washing dishes itself disappears. I used to think a dishwasher was a luxury, but after actually using it, it's not just a convenience; it's a necessity. The end of the day feels much lighter.

Sentence (English): I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher because I've always found washing dishes a burden in my busy life.

Sentence (English): I asked my husband to buy me a dishwasher for my birthday.
Comments (English): I asked my husband to buy me a dishwasher for my birthday. Seriously, dishwashing used to be the hardest thing in the world, but since Auntie came, my quality of life has changed. I leave all the heavy-duty utensils like spoons, chopsticks, rice and soup bowls, plates, tongs, and side dish containers to Auntie. I only have to wash two or three large items like the rice cooker and soup pot, so I don't have to stand at the sink for long periods. Since it's only for six people, it can't hold all the pots and pans, but it's a whole new world to share the work with Auntie. Plus, she opens and dries them for me, so I just have to put them away the next day (they're already dry). Seriously, the most convenient thing is my kid's tumbler and my husband's tumbler. I can't even reach them, and I hated having to scrub them with long, sticky sponges all the time. But Auntie cleans them so thoroughly that I'm super, super happy. And if anyone's wondering what detergent to buy for this dishwasher, I recommend Sway. Dishwasher shampoo and water stain remover? It's a combination, so you just throw it in the bottom of the dishwasher and it cleans well without any stains or anything (and there's no foam or anything at the bottom~ Make sure to buy the one for 6 people or they say it doesn't clean well because it has too much detergent~). My life has become so much more efficient since my grandmother came to visit these days. This is a sincere review. . Recommendations are love.

Overall, I like the LG dishwasher's design and performance. It's also great! I've been using Samsung products since my newlywed package, but since my kitchen dishwasher is 15cm wide, I didn't want to worry about cutting it or anything like that, so I chose an LG product. I was looking for one with the highest ratings and a price tag of around 1 million won, and I ended up buying this one. The ivory color really suits my kitchen, and it looks calm and sophisticated. When I first used it, I didn't know how to use it, so it dripped and I was like, "What the heck?" But after learning more and using it for the second time, it worked relatively smoothly! If there had been something else, I would have been very stressed. I hope you keep your appointments very strictly. Installation took about an hour. Sentence (English): I'll start by saying I'm a handyman.
Comments (English): [ Very Frustrated - leaking ] || ---------------- || I'll start by saying I'm a handyman. I generally read reviews, order the item, and find that the concerns outlined in the reviews aren't that bad if you have general knowledge of how to do little fixes. This dishwasher is NOT the case. The dishwasher worked great for about a week before it leaked from under the front of the unit. No big deal, we bought a protection plan for a reason. Bodewell (GE contractor) came out two weeks after the initial leak. The guy threw some parts at it, let it run a few minutes and left. It leaked again from the same spot after a couple cycles. Put in another ticket and had to wait another 2-3 weeks for the same guy to arrive. During that trip, he had to order an entire door panel and some other parts, which took another 2-3 weeks before parts were here and he came to replace them. So about 6ish weeks at this point. He changed the parts, ran it again for a few minutes, and left. I wish I would have been here instead of my wife for this one. It leaked within an hour after he left. To add to all this, the leak migrated into our floors over time, which led to delamination, swelling, and mold in the floors under the DW. To add, the dishwasher shifted as the floors under its legs deteriorated, and it now has damaged the cabinets that it was mounted to. So, I started a claim with GE insurance, and wouldn't you know it, it is a HUGE headache. They are asking me to find a contractor, hunt around for the same floor boards that were installed 15 years ago, fill out a confusing form and send damaged floor board samples into some flooring place if I can't find the same floors. Basically I'm left with damaged floors, damaged cabinets, and a dishwasher that leaks while I wait another two weeks for the repairman to come and give us another synopsis. At this rate, I bet I don't have a functioning dishwasher with restored floors/cabinets by summer. I hope nobody ever has this experience, because it is absolutely terrible. Oh, and I found the leak myself. It's internal to the unit and I see no way of repairing it without a complete tear-down or replacement, but what do I know. I was going to leave my other new appliances alone, but I think GE has a quality problem so I'll hop over to the stove I bought and let everyone know that I had to remove the entire back of the stove to tighten screws that were half installed, making the top control panel wobble when you pushed the buttons.

Bodewell (GE contractor) came out two weeks after the initial leak. The guy threw some parts at it, let it run a few minutes and left. It leaked again from the same spot after a couple cycles. Sentence (English): I purchased this GE Profile UltraFresh dishwasher in November 2024.
Comments (English): [ Insulation failure and disappointing warranty exp ] || ---------------- || I purchased this GE Profile UltraFresh dishwasher in November 2024. In terms of cleaning performance and noise level, it has worked well. However, during the first year of ownership, a factory-installed sound-dampening insulation component began deteriorating and later delaminated and fell off from underneath the unit. Multiple pieces have detached over the past couple months, which should not happen with a premium appliance at this price point.This appears to be a materials or workmanship issue rather than normal wear. I also purchased the 5-Year Lowe's Protection Plan for added peace of mind, but when I filed a claim, it was not approved and displayed the message: “Claim Not Approved. You can't proceed with your claim as it is not approved for the following reason: Denied, No Coverage.”I plan on contacting GE for service, but it appears repairs may require out-of-pocket costs for an issue that originated during the first year of ownership. Sentence (English): I got Bosch because of its reputation for reliability and cleaning the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Leaking within a year, weird controls, washes well ] || ---------------- || I got Bosch because of its reputation for reliability and cleaning the dishes. Well, it did a decent job on the latter, but after just 11 months, it's leaking and needs to be serviced. At least it has a base pan that catches the leaks, but blips my previous dishwasher from a different maker, but I was really hoping it would go longer before needing servicing. And the controls are weird. The touch buttons are finicky and it can be hard to know if touching the start button registered as there is no light for that button to indicate that you pushed it, just a quiet ding that you might now hear. And if you open it mid cycle and close it again, it won't keep running. You have to hit start again. Good luck getting your kids to remember that. On the bright side, the reason they open if mid cycle is because it's very quiet when running. And if you ever change your mind after selecting a cycle but before pushing to start, good luck. You can't just push the button for a different cycle. Nope, instead, you have to hold the power button for 4 seconds and then close it to let it drain the empty basin and do a full reset. So annoying. And now that it's leaking, I regret the purpose and find the quirky controls all the more grating.

Sentence (English): I had a Bosch dishwasher that I loved, but if finally died and I couldn't get the parts to repair it, so I decided I'd try this, because I love my Kitchenaid mixer - it's a workhorse and has been going strong for years.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as my Bosch was ] || ---------------- || I had a Bosch dishwasher that I loved, but if finally died and I couldn't get the parts to repair it, so I decided I'd try this, because I love my Kitchenaid mixer - it's a workhorse and has been going strong for years. Big mistake. I regret everything about this purchase. Although rated quieter, it's louder than my old Bosch was. It cleans ok, but not nearly as well as my old one, either. The prongs are too far apart and make it hard to keep glasses upright. The design of the racks is just not well thought out at all, especially the 3rd rack at the top. Nothing fits really well. It only has one option for delay - 4 hours, so if you need more or less you're hosed. There's no display to see how long is left on the cycle. It doesn't remember your cycle choices so you have to put them in every time. When it's done you have to open the door, re-latch it, and open it again to get the "clean" light to go off, which is just an irritation. And the delivery process? Oh my gosh. Was supposed to be delivered within a week. It took 4, with it being cancelled about 2 hours before the delivery window twice. So I had to take off work to be home for the delivery three times. No apology, just "eh, sorry about that". They finally refunded the delivery fee, but the overall attitude was that they didn't care. So between the terrible customer service and the VERY sub-par performance and lack of features of this dishwasher, I have the worst case of buyer's remorse. Do yourself a favor and get a Bosch. I've cancelled the extended warranty on this because I don't want it fixed (and am fearful of how bad an experience that would be anyway given the lack of customer service the sale had). I'll just happily replace it when it dies.

Comments (English): [ An innovative, useful, quiet, modern dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has a modern design and some innovative features. The dishwasher has stainless steel inside and out which is a nice touch. There are 3 racks with the middle one being adjustable with a quick easy press of 2 buttons. The top rack is a skinny rack for silverware/ cutlery which I must say is nice for those times you have a lot of other dishes as you can use the top rack for silverware and take out the basket on the bottom rack. The top rack is also removable if you need more room on the middle rack. The dishwasher also is equipped with ThinQ, where you can download an app and do things like remote start, " download cycles", diagnostics, energy monitoring, and access to the user manual. In my mind the ThinQ app and controls in the app are more hype than useful, it is nice to have a diagnostic ability depending on how much information you'd actually get, the download cycles gives the ability to choose one of 9 special settings like pots and pans, tub clean etc and program it to the download button on the machine, but the fact you can only program one program at a time through the app seems less than ideal vs just having a button that you could perhaps cycle through the options? the remote start I really can't think of a time I would need to use it especially since you need to turn the machine on press remote start then use the app. I'll let you decide whether the ThinQ is something that is for you. But otherwise the machine seems to do a good job, it cleans well, is fairly quiet and looks nice. Installation is fairly straightforward, make sure you have the right size opening ( 23 3/4" wide x 33 5/8 high x 23 3/4 deep) , and your water and electric are within the recommended areas. The machine can be flush mounted however as seen in my picture mine sticks out a bit due to a 3/4 inch support on the back of my cabinet. The electrical hookup is simple with an electrical box on the front of the machine and wire nutting hot to hot neutral to neutral and ground to ground. For leveling there are the 2 front feet which you can use the 1/************* drive of a rachet, or use a 1/2 inch socket on the top of the foot or use a flat blade screwdriver to push the foot itself. The rear foot has an adjustment screw on the front center making it very easy to adjust. Overall a very nice dishwasher.

The top rack is a skinny rack for silverware/ cutlery which I must say is nice for those times you have a lot of other dishes as you can use the top rack for silverware and take out the basket on the bottom rack. The top rack is also removable if you need more room on the middle rack. The dishwasher also is equipped with ThinQ, where you can download an app and do things like remote start, " download cycles", diagnostics, energy monitoring, and access to the user manual. In my mind the ThinQ app and controls in the app are more hype than useful, it is nice to have a diagnostic ability depending on how much information you'd actually get, the download cycles gives the ability to choose one of 9 special settings like pots and pans, tub clean etc and program it to the download button on the machine, but the fact you can only program one program at a time through the app seems less than ideal vs just having a button that you could perhaps cycle through the options? the remote start I really can't think of a time I would need to use it especially since you need to turn the machine on press remote start then use the app. I'll let you decide whether the ThinQ is something that is for you. But otherwise the machine seems to do a good job, it cleans well, is fairly quiet and looks nice. Installation is fairly straightforward, make sure you have the right size opening ( 23 3/4" wide x 33 5/8 high x 23 3/4 deep) , and your water and electric are within the recommended areas. The machine can be flush mounted however as seen in my picture mine sticks out a bit due to a 3/4 inch support on the back of my cabinet. The electrical hookup is simple with an electrical box on the front of the machine and wire nutting hot to hot neutral to neutral and ground to ground. For leveling there are the 2 front feet which you can use the 1/************* drive of a rachet, or use a 1/2 inch socket on the top of the foot or use a flat blade screwdriver to push the foot itself. The rear foot has an adjustment screw on the front center making it very easy to adjust. Overall a very nice dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Cleaning: 4.5/5 Drying: 4/5 Quietness: 4.5/5 Aesthetics: 5/5 Price: 4/5 This is my first Bosch.
Comments (English): [ It's the little things ] || ---------------- || Cleaning: 4.5/5 Drying: 4/5 Quietness: 4.5/5 Aesthetics: 5/5 Price: 4/5 This is my first Bosch. Replacing an 8 year old GE Profile (which replaced a 17 year old GE Profile). I purchased the Bosch based on recommendations from three friends and one appliance repair person. It was a few hundred dollars more than the GE Profile I compared it to. Ultimately, I decided to go with Bosch because of the high reliability ratings from Consumer Reports. The dishwasher does an excellent job cleaning; only once or twice have I had a single item not get 100% clean. It dries pretty well; I don't use a lot of plastics but as far as most other things, there is usually only residual water if a dish was not properly placed to allow for runoff. The dishwasher is very quiet although not silent like my previous one. This is my first dishwasher with a third rack. Silverware and utensils placed in the third rack get very clean; I think cleaner than a utensil basket on the bottom rack. There are things I preferred in my old dishwasher however. I felt like I could get a lot more items in my old dishwasher. The third rack prevents taller items (water bottles and wine glasses) from being placed in the second rack unless you drop the second rack down. When you do so, however, regular dinner plates on the bottom rack then hit the washing arm above them (it's attached to the underside of the second rack). Also, the provided wine glass holders that attach to wine glass stems do not fit my wine glass stems so they are useless to me (and I haven't seen how I can remove them). I use wine glasses fairly often so I feel like I'll have to figure out another solution for stem security, lower the second rack, and not wash dinner plates in the same load. That is unfortunate. At this price, I would also expect the second rack to have adjustable tines; mine does not. The bottom rack holds a lot of plates, more than I would load before running the dishwasher. So that's great if you use a lot of plates rather than a lot of bowls. If more of the bottom rack's tines were adjustable, I could get more larger items to fit. Just a portion of this dishwasher's bottom rack tines are adjustable. I have read on user forums that users feel the dishwasher develops odors due to residual water remaining (in the pump? Filter? ); I haven't noticed that yet but I do leave the dishwasher door open at night. You really can't leave it ajar during the day because it is too far ajar to not be in your way. The app is useful for receiving messages about refilling the rinse aid, the cycle is complete, etc. Overall, I am reasonably happy with this purchase and if it turns out to be reliable for many years, then it is worth a few of these inconveniences. If it turns out to have a shorter life (like almost anything you purchase these days), then I may go back to GE to save money.

It was a few hundred dollars more than the GE Profile I compared it to. Ultimately, I decided to go with Bosch because of the high reliability ratings from Consumer Reports. The dishwasher does an excellent job cleaning; only once or twice have I had a single item not get 100% clean. It dries pretty well; I don't use a lot of plastics but as far as most other things, there is usually only residual water if a dish was not properly placed to allow for runoff. The dishwasher is very quiet although not silent like my previous one. This is my first dishwasher with a third rack. Silverware and utensils placed in the third rack get very clean; I think cleaner than a utensil basket on the bottom rack. There are things I preferred in my old dishwasher however. I felt like I could get a lot more items in my old dishwasher. The third rack prevents taller items (water bottles and wine glasses) from being placed in the second rack unless you drop the second rack down. When you do so, however, regular dinner plates on the bottom rack then hit the washing arm above them (it's attached to the underside of the second rack). Also, the provided wine glass holders that attach to wine glass stems do not fit my wine glass stems so they are useless to me (and I haven't seen how I can remove them). I use wine glasses fairly often so I feel like I'll have to figure out another solution for stem security, lower the second rack, and not wash dinner plates in the same load. That is unfortunate. At this price, I would also expect the second rack to have adjustable tines; mine does not. The bottom rack holds a lot of plates, more than I would load before running the dishwasher. So that's great if you use a lot of plates rather than a lot of bowls. If more of the bottom rack's tines were adjustable, I could get more larger items to fit. Just a portion of this dishwasher's bottom rack tines are adjustable. I have read on user forums that users feel the dishwasher develops odors due to residual water remaining (in the pump? Filter? ); I haven't noticed that yet but I do leave the dishwasher door open at night. You really can't leave it ajar during the day because it is too far ajar to not be in your way. The app is useful for receiving messages about refilling the rinse aid, the cycle is complete, etc. Overall, I am reasonably happy with this purchase and if it turns out to be reliable for many years, then it is worth a few of these inconveniences. If it turns out to have a shorter life (like almost anything you purchase these days), then I may go back to GE to save money.

(see attached pics and video). The dishes and utensils are, for the most part, dry; however, when the water pours from the various spaces, then they get wet before we can get them out. What is the vent in the upper left corner of the front for? It just leaks water down the front of the dishwasher and into the floor. Plus, all the appliances are advertised as fingerprint resistant stainless steel. They are not! (forgot to add this on the review of the fridge)

Comments (English): Since it is said to be great for living alone or in a newlywed home, I will summarize it based on actual usage.  **Pros** * Good space efficiency (countertop type). Since it sits on top of the sink rather than being built-in, installation is less of a hassle. It is especially well-suited for studio apartments and small kitchens. * Cleaning power is better than expected. Even greasy dishes are cleaned reasonably well on the basic cycle, and since it uses less water, it saves water compared to hand washing. * It is a 6-place setting, so it is perfect for 1-2 person households. It is not for a huge amount at once, but the capacity is sufficient for washing a day's worth of dishes. * Design (Bespoke vibe). With its clean colors and mini-appliance feel, a major advantage is that it does not detract from the kitchen interior.  **Cons** * Drying performance is not perfect. It feels more like natural drying, so some moisture may remain; it is best to leave the door open. * Difficult to fit large dishes. Large pots and pans are limited, so you end up hand-washing some of them as well. * The noise level is not 'completely quiet.' It is at the level of everyday noise, though. It might be a concern in a studio apartment. . Summary of actual specs and impressions. * Wash cycle is approximately 95 minutes. * Water consumption is based on approximately 1.6L per person. * Size is approximately 55cm (can be installed on a kitchen counter). . . Overall review. Feels like an entry-level dishwasher that reduces dishwashing stress. * Recommended for: 1-2 person households / living alone / newlyweds / people who find dishwashing a hassle. * Not recommended for: Large families / households that frequently use large pots. Sentence (English): Cleaning: 4.5/5.
Comments (English): [ It's the little things ] || ---------------- || Cleaning: 4.5/5. Drying: 4/5. Quietness: 4.5/5. Aesthetics: 5/5. Price: 4/5. This is my first Bosch. Replacing an 8 year old GE Profile (which replaced a 17 year old GE Profile). I purchased the Bosch based on recommendations from three friends and one appliance repair person. It was a few hundred dollars more than the GE Profile I compared it to. Ultimately, I decided to go with Bosch because of the high reliability ratings from Consumer Reports. The dishwasher does an excellent job cleaning; only once or twice have I had a single item not get 100% clean. It dries pretty well; I don't use a lot of plastics but as far as most other things, there is usually only residual water if a dish was not properly placed to allow for runoff. The dishwasher is very quiet although not silent like my previous one. This is my first dishwasher with a third rack. Silverware and utensils placed in the third rack get very clean; I think cleaner than a utensil basket on the bottom rack. There are things I preferred in my old dishwasher however. I felt like I could get a lot more items in my old dishwasher. The third rack prevents taller items (water bottles and wine glasses) from being placed in the second rack unless you drop the second rack down. When you do so, however, regular dinner plates on the bottom rack then hit the washing arm above them (it's attached to the underside of the second rack). Also, the provided wine glass holders that attach to wine glass stems do not fit my wine glass stems so they are useless to me (and I haven't seen how I can remove them). I use wine glasses fairly often so I feel like I'll have to figure out another solution for stem security, lower the second rack, and not wash dinner plates in the same load. That is unfortunate. At this price, I would also expect the second rack to have adjustable tines; mine does not. The bottom rack holds a lot of plates, more than I would load before running the dishwasher. So that's great if you use a lot of plates rather than a lot of bowls. If more of the bottom rack's tines were adjustable, I could get more larger items to fit. Just a portion of this dishwasher's bottom rack tines are adjustable. I have read on user forums that users feel the dishwasher develops odors due to residual water remaining (in the pump? Filter? ); I haven't noticed that yet but I do leave the dishwasher door open at night. You really can't leave it ajar during the day because it is too far ajar to not be in your way. The app is useful for receiving messages about refilling the rinse aid, the cycle is complete, etc. Overall, I am reasonably happy with this purchase and if it turns out to be reliable for many years, then it is worth a few of these inconveniences. If it turns out to have a shorter life (like almost anything you purchase these days), then I may go back to GE to save money.

The appliances were delivered on Oct. 13th, 2025 and we would have had until the 27th to return or report any damage. I just wanted to share that information in case anyone else considers making a purchase during a sale with intentions of storing them for any amount of time over 2 weeks.e

Sentence (English): I finally installed an LG dishwasher in my home.
Comments (English): I finally installed an LG dishwasher in my home. Honestly, it was quite a struggle to even get to this point. I initially sent a Samsung dishwasher to my mother's house as a gift on January 1st. But the pre-inspection team kept coming, and the actual installation was delayed. They visited three times by the 15th, but nothing happened. The explanations kept changing, and it was getting tiring and frustrating for the waiters. Ultimately, I decided to cancel everything. So, I chose an LG dishwasher and switched to Coupang for the purchase. To cut to the chase, I wondered why I hadn't done this sooner. They contacted me within two days of my purchase, and the installer was quickly scheduled. Best of all, they handled everything from the kitchen remodeling to the built-in installation all in one go. There were no more calls or extra trips, and it was a breeze. The installer was very thorough in his explanations, making the instructions and precautions easy to understand. The nature beige color really brightened up the kitchen. I'm always satisfied with the way the appliances blend into the interior without standing out. Above all, the installation was completed in one go, without any waiting or stress. I truly realized this time how different the experience can be, even with the same dishwasher purchase, based on a single installation experience. If you're worried about the installation schedule, it's much easier to choose a one-time installation from the beginning, rather than worrying unnecessarily like I did. Please note that all the information in this review is based on my own purchase! If you found this review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button.

At first I was impressed with how well it cleaned the dishes - until I used the middle rack for cereal bowls! (The bowls were rinsed clean before being placed in the dishwasher.) The bowls weren't nested into each other but every other bowl ended up covered with tiny white granules & specs on the inside (soap granules? ) and had to be washed again by hand. I'm not sure what caused this. Because of the holidays I'd had it about 35 days before I was able to make the trade to a more expensive Bosch dishwasher with proven reliability (I've owned 2 previously). Never again will I second guess a purchase in an attempt to save money. It's definitely not worth it.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is not recommended.
Comments (English): [ Mind of its own ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is not recommended. When it works I'm happy with it. I like the interior layout- fits a lot of dishes and cleans well. I did a LOT of research before purchasing this- wanted something that would accommodate us and be reliable, and liked buttons in front with timer to see from a distance. But I have lived in a number of houses over the years and never had any issues with any dishwashers until now, with this GE we bought brand new and had professionally installed. In spite of service calls (included replacing the electric control panel) it still has its fits and goes bezerk from time to time, flipping between settings with zero human interaction, ignoring pushing of buttons, locking itself, etc etc. This evening when I just wanted to get the load started after a long day it has acted up yet again - enough is enough and this review screen came up when i scanned for service, so here it is. One evening we realized it was stuck on a draining setting for over an hour and the house smelled of a burned motor- thankfully there wasn't a fire! That lead to another part being replaced- that issue hasn't recurred but it was due to a faulty part they no longer include in new models (notice: realize a number of units still have that part! ) We have a lemon with electric gremlins and it still acts up - like this evening- and unfortunately due to its unreliability and safety concerns I cannot recommend this product. It is still in warranty and who knows if GE will actually replace this with a unit that always works. I have so many videos of it acting up. I tried to include one recorded a moment ago but the file wouldn't upload.

Sentence (English): Not the “true” 800 Series cleaning experience I purchased the Bosch 800 Series expecting top-tier cleaning performance based on the series reputation and prior 800 models.
Comments (English): [ Not the “true” 800 Series cleaning experience ] || ---------------- || Not the “true” 800 Series cleaning experience I purchased the Bosch 800 Series expecting top-tier cleaning performance based on the series reputation and prior 800 models. While this dishwasher is very quiet and drying performance with CrystalDry is excellent, the actual cleaning system is disappointing for the price. This newer DM revision uses Bosch's standard PrecisionWash system, which is essentially the same core wash mechanics found in lower 300 and basic 500 series models. Older 800 models (CM variants) had PowerControl with targeted spray, which is no longer included. That change is not clearly communicated at purchase. For households that cook oily or heavy foods, the lack of any targeted or boosted wash zone is noticeable. Some 500-series models even offer Zone Wash, which makes the current 800 feel poorly positioned. The controls and display also feel simplified for a premium product — no real time display, just a basic InfoLight and app reliance. Overall: • Excellent drying and quietness • Reliable, but not premium cleaning performance • Feels overpriced for what is effectively a standard wash system

Comments (English): [ A Premium 18-Inch Dishwasher That Justifies Its Pr ] || ---------------- || After living with the Bosch SPE53C55UC for a while, I can confidently say it's an excellent dishwasher and one I would absolutely purchase again. In the narrow 18-inch dishwasher category, there simply aren't many options to choose from, and while this model sits on the higher end of the price range, it is absolutely worth the investment.Pros:This dishwasher does a consistently excellent job cleaning dishes. Everything comes out spotless, even with heavily soiled loads, and it does so while operating very quietly. The overall construction feels solid and well thought out, with a level of quality you'd expect at this price point.One standout feature is the rear leveling foot that can be adjusted from the front of the machine. This makes leveling the dishwasher after installation incredibly easy and is a huge quality-of-life improvement compared to other units. Honestly, this feature alone is worth the premium price.Fit and finish are very nice, and as an 18-inch-wide dishwasher, the third rack is incredibly useful. It adds meaningful capacity in a compact footprint and includes provisions for holding large kitchen knives, which is a thoughtful and practical touch. Another detail I appreciate is that all utility connections are located on the back of the machine, unlike some models that place them at the front—this makes installation cleaner and more straightforward.Cons:As others have mentioned, plastic dishes don't come out perfectly dry. To me, this feels like a very minor tradeoff given how well the dishwasher performs overall. I simply leave the door cracked open after the cycle finishes, which allows any remaining moisture to evaporate and has made this a non-issue in daily use.The included silverware basket does feel somewhat fragile, and I suspect it may not hold up as well over time compared to the rest of the machine. While it hasn't failed yet, it's the one component that doesn't quite match the otherwise excellent build quality.Overall:Given the limited selection of 18-inch dishwashers on the market, the Bosch SPE53C55UC stands out as a top-tier option. The minor drawbacks are far outweighed by its cleaning performance, quiet operation, thoughtful design, and quality construction, making it a dishwasher I would happily purchase again.

Sentence (English): Not the “true” 800 Series cleaning experience.
Comments (English): Not the “true” 800 Series cleaning experience. I purchased the Bosch 800 Series expecting top-tier cleaning performance based on the series reputation and prior 800 models. While this dishwasher is very quiet and drying performance with CrystalDry is excellent, the actual cleaning system is disappointing for the price. This newer DM revision uses Bosch's standard PrecisionWash system, which is essentially the same core wash mechanics found in lower 300 and basic 500 series models. Older 800 models (CM variants) had PowerControl with targeted spray, which is no longer included. That change is not clearly communicated at purchase. For households that cook oily or heavy foods, the lack of any targeted or boosted wash zone is noticeable. Some 500-series models even offer Zone Wash, which makes the current 800 feel poorly positioned. The controls and display also feel simplified for a premium product — no real time display, just a basic InfoLight and app reliance. Overall:. • Excellent drying and quietness. • Reliable, but not premium cleaning performance. • Feels overpriced for what is effectively a standard wash system

Sentence (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. Sentence (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): I'm also very satisfied with the drying function.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the design and interior design. Its powerful cleaning and sterilizing power are excellent. Its large capacity makes it convenient to use. It even has automatic drying and smart features. It's a well-equipped product, so I can definitely recommend it to anyone considering a dishwasher. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.

Sentence (English): Weighing 43kg, it's been stable and comfortable since its built-in installation.
Comments (English): Honestly, I understand why people say that once you start using a dishwasher, it's hard to go back to handwashing. The LG Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher I recently installed is a product I'm extremely satisfied with, from its design to its performance. First of all, the Objet Collection Nature Beige color is absolutely beautiful. It's understated yet luxurious, and it blends seamlessly with my kitchen interior. Its built-in design makes the entire kitchen feel much more organized. It's an appliance, but it feels like furniture, and I'm always satisfied with it. When it comes to performance, LG is unwavering. The 100C True Steam function ensures reliable sterilization. It claims to eliminate 99.999% of harmful bacteria, so I can use it with confidence, even on children's dishes or other dishes I'm concerned about hygiene. Even greasy dishes and stuck-on food come out clean after washing, leaving the dishwasher feeling much cleaner than when I wash by hand. I especially love the Tornado cleaning blade. The powerful water jets from all directions ensure even cleaning without having to worry about the position of the dishes. Even heavily greased dishes like frying pans and pots are cleaned in one go. The large capacity for 14 people means I only need to do it once a day. Since it can hold dishes, cups, and pots all at once, the stress of piling up dishes is greatly reduced. The well-organized interior makes organizing dishes a breeze, and the capacity is perfect for a family. I'm also very satisfied with the drying function. Thanks to the automatic door opening, the door opens slightly after the wash is finished, allowing the dishes to dry naturally. This virtually eliminates water stains and quickly removes moisture from the interior. It's incredibly convenient because it automatically does the job without having to keep the door open. Another great feature is the UP feature. I was amazed by how the features update while I was using it, and the fact that it maintains the latest features over time is highly satisfying. It's not just a great appliance for the moment, but also a product I'll want to keep for a long time. It's also a top-rated energy-efficient product, which reduces electricity bills. And with a single wash using only 14.5 liters of water, it's significantly more economical than washing dishes by hand. My time in the kitchen has become much more comfortable, and the stress of washing dishes has disappeared, significantly improving my quality of life. Since installing it, I'm so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't get it sooner.
